text_block_list.text:
Lately, spending time at the academy has made me think.
...How should I put it...?

text_block_list.name: Ashen-Faced Trainer
text_block_list.text: Just a bit... a bit more, and I'll have... worked out... the optimal training method...

text_block_list.name: Trainer with Dark Circles
text_block_list.text:
My head... won't work...
Behind my eyes... it's burning...

It's a Trainer's nature.
When it comes to their Umamusume,
they easily push past their own limits...

Fatigue impacts performance.
Without rest, you can't give it your best.
Even knowing that in my head...!

――Yu~~~koma is such a lovely place...♪
――With such wonderful ho~t spring water...♪

It's Landlady Hoshina and her crew from the Yukoma Ryokan,
famous for Umamusume health retreats...!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Yes, indeed.
The young proprietress and I will gladly drop by.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Everyone looks terribly exhausted,
so if I may be so bold,
I came to suggest taking some rest.

text_block_list.name: Ashen-Faced Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Thank... you...
But I'm fine... so I need to get going...

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: Please wait.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Could you show that face
to your Umamusume?

text_block_list.name: Trainer with Dark Circles
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
If you collapse because of pushing yourself for them,
those girls will only end up heartbroken.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Yes, which is why you must come.
To our hot spring inn.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Relieves fatigue and boosts blood circulation.
For your assigned Umamusume, we also offer hot spring therapy trial sessions~.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
We have everything you seek.
Now, right this way... the shuttle bus is over there.

text_block_list.name: Exhausted People
text_block_list.text:
Ooh... Ooooh...!
G-Goddess...!
choice_data_list: Everyone's being guided toward the bus...!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: ――Good grief, Trainers never change, whether back then or now.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Make sure you come to me before you hit your limit.
...Got it?
